name: Restaurant Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your restaurant insurance cost. Free calculator for restaurants, cafes, bars, and food service businesses.
inputs: Restaurant type, number of seats, annual revenue, primary state
formula: Base rate $2800-$9500 by restaurant type. Seat multiplier for 20+ seats. Revenue multiplier for $200K+. State multiplier (CA 1.25, TX 1.05, FL 1.20, NY 1.35).

name: General Liability Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your general liability insurance cost. Free calculator for small business owners, contractors, and service providers.
inputs: Industry, annual revenue, number of employees, primary state
formula: Base rate $600-$2200 by industry. Revenue multiplier for revenue over $100K. Employee factor. State multiplier (CA 1.25, TX 1.10, FL 1.20, NY 1.30).

name: Commercial Truck Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your commercial truck insurance costs. Free calculator for owner-operators and small fleets. Instant premium estimate.
inputs: Business type, annual revenue, number of trucks, primary state, cargo type
formula: Base rate $8000-$22000 by business type. Cargo multiplier (general 1.0, refrigerated 1.15, flatbed 1.25, hazmat 1.75). State multiplier. Fleet discount for 2+ trucks.

name: Business Interruption Insurance Calculator
description: Calculate how much business interruption coverage your business needs to protect against lost income during a covered closure.
inputs: Monthly revenue, monthly fixed expenses, months of coverage needed, industry type
formula: Coverage limit = (monthly revenue - monthly expenses) * months + (monthly expenses * months). Premium = coverage limit * 0.005-0.009 depending on industry.

name: Commercial Auto Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your commercial auto insurance cost. Free calculator for business vehicles and fleets. Instant premium estimate.
inputs: Vehicle type, number of vehicles, business use, state
formula: Base rate per vehicle $1400-$6500 by vehicle type. Use multiplier and state factor applied. Fleet discounts for 2+ vehicles.

name: Commercial Umbrella Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your commercial umbrella insurance cost. Enter revenue and underlying policy limits for instant premium estimates.
inputs: Industry, annual revenue, employees, underlying general liability limit, desired umbrella limit
formula: Base rate $800-$3000 depending on industry. Umbrella multiplier = 0.1% of selected limit. Industry and revenue adjustments applied.

name: Employment Practices Liability Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your EPLI insurance cost. Covers wrongful termination, discrimination, and harassment claims.
inputs: Number of employees, annual revenue, state, industry, claims history
formula: Base per-employee rate of $40-$120. Revenue factor and state adjustments. Claims history multiplier.

name: Inland Marine Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your inland marine insurance cost for tools, equipment, and goods in transit.
inputs: Total equipment value, industry, annual revenue, transit coverage needed
formula: Rate per $100 of insured value varies $0.30-$1.20 depending on industry and transit exposure.

name: Short-Term Rental Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your Airbnb or VRBO insurance cost. Covers property, liability, and lost rental income.
inputs: Property value, annual rental revenue, location, property type, nightly rate
formula: Base rate 1.5-3% of annual rental revenue. Property value factor and location adjustment.

name: Home-Based Business Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your home-based business insurance cost. Covers liability, equipment, and business interruption.
inputs: Industry, annual revenue, business equipment value, client visits to home
formula: Base rate $500-$1500 depending on industry. Equipment value and client traffic adjustments.

name: Cleaning Business Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your cleaning business insurance cost. Covers liability, bonding, and workers comp.
inputs: Revenue, number of employees, residential or commercial focus, state
formula: Base GL rate $800-$2500. Workers comp based on payroll and class code 9014/9015.

name: Landscaping Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your landscaping or lawn care business insurance cost. Covers liability, workers comp, and commercial auto.
inputs: Revenue, employees, equipment value, vehicles, state
formula: Base GL $1200-$3000. Workers comp class 0042. Commercial auto per-vehicle rate.

name: Salon Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your hair salon or barbershop insurance cost. Covers general liability, property, and professional liability.
inputs: Revenue, number of stylists, chairs, services offered (chemical treatments add risk)
formula: Base GL $700-$1500. Professional liability adds $300-$800. Property based on value.

name: Auto Repair Shop Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your auto repair shop insurance cost. Covers garage liability, garage keepers, and property.
inputs: Revenue, number of bays, employees, vehicles kept overnight, state
formula: Garage liability $2500-$6000. Garage keepers based on value of customer vehicles. Workers comp class 8380.

name: Retail Store Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your retail store insurance cost. Covers liability, property, and inventory.
inputs: Revenue, square footage, inventory value, product type, state
formula: Base GL $500-$1500. Property based on building and inventory value. Product liability for certain retail types.

name: Electrician Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your electrician business insurance cost. Covers liability, workers comp, and tools.
inputs: Revenue, employees, state, commercial vs residential focus
formula: GL $1500-$3500. Workers comp class 5190 at $3-$6 per $100 payroll. Tools coverage based on value.

name: Plumber Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your plumbing business insurance cost. Covers liability, workers comp, and commercial auto.
inputs: Revenue, employees, vehicles, state, service or new construction
formula: GL $1200-$3000. Workers comp class 5183 at $2-$5 per $100 payroll. Commercial auto per vehicle.

name: Roofing Contractor Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your roofing contractor insurance cost. Covers liability, workers comp, and equipment.
inputs: Revenue, employees, subcontractor usage, state, residential or commercial
formula: GL $2500-$6000. Workers comp class 5551 at $8-$15 per $100 payroll. Highest risk trade.

name: Event Planner Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your event planning business insurance cost. Covers liability, cancellation, and vendor issues.
inputs: Annual revenue, events per year, average event size, alcohol served at events
formula: GL $500-$1500. Event cancellation $500-$2000 based on event value. Liquor liability if alcohol served.

name: Personal Trainer Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your personal trainer insurance cost. Covers liability and professional liability.
inputs: Revenue, clients, online or in-person, studio or gym-based
formula: Base policy $200-$600 per year. Professional liability adds $100-$300. Coverage limits affect premium.

name: Dental Office Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your dental practice insurance cost. Covers malpractice, property, and workers comp.
inputs: Number of dentists, hygienists, staff, annual revenue, state
formula: Malpractice $2000-$8000 per dentist. GL and property based on office size. Workers comp class 8832.

name: Medical Office Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your medical practice insurance cost. Covers malpractice, property, and business interruption.
inputs: Specialty, number of providers, staff, revenue, state
formula: Malpractice varies by specialty $3000-$20000 per provider. Property and GL based on office.

name: Daycare Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your daycare or childcare insurance cost. Covers liability, property, and abuse coverage.
inputs: Number of children, staff, home-based or commercial, state
formula: GL $1500-$4000. Abuse coverage required in most states. Workers comp class 8834.

name: Nonprofit Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your nonprofit organization insurance cost. Covers D&O, GL, and property.
inputs: Annual budget, number of staff, board size, services offered
formula: D&O $800-$3000. GL $500-$1500. Property based on assets. Total package discounts available.

name: IT Consultant Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your IT consultant insurance cost. Covers E&O, cyber, and general liability.
inputs: Revenue, clients, services offered, data handled, employees
formula: E&O $800-$2500. Cyber $500-$2000 based on records handled. GL $500-$1200.

name: Real Estate Agent E&O Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your real estate E&O insurance cost. Required in most states for licensed agents.
inputs: Annual commission revenue, transactions per year, state, brokerage size
formula: Base E&O $400-$900. Per-transaction rate $25-$75. State requirements vary.

name: Trucking Cargo Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your cargo insurance cost. Covers freight in transit up to your policy limit.
inputs: Annual revenue, cargo value per load, cargo type, coverage limit
formula: Rate per $1000 of cargo value $0.50-$2.00. Hazmat higher. Coverage limit $100k typical.

name: Garage Keepers Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your garage keepers insurance cost. Covers customer vehicles in your care.
inputs: Number of vehicles on premises, average vehicle value, type of business
formula: Rate 1-3% of maximum value of vehicles in care. Auto dealers, repair shops, and valet services.

name: Farm Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your farm or ranch insurance cost. Covers property, equipment, livestock, and liability.
inputs: Acreage, farm type, building value, equipment value, livestock value, revenue
formula: Farm package based on total insured value. Crop insurance separate. Livestock coverage per head.

name: HVAC Contractor Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your HVAC contractor insurance cost. Covers liability, workers comp, and commercial auto.
inputs: Revenue, employees, vehicles, state, residential or commercial
formula: GL $1800-$4000. Workers comp class 5537. Commercial auto per vehicle. Refrigerant coverage add-on.

name: Cybersecurity Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your cybersecurity insurance cost. Covers ransomware, data breaches, and regulatory fines.
inputs: Revenue, records stored, industry, security controls in place
formula: Base rate 0.05-0.30% of revenue. Records factor. Security controls discounts up to 30%.

name: Small Business Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your small business insurance cost. Bundles general liability and property into a BOP.
inputs: Industry, revenue, employees, property value, state
formula: BOP base $500-$3000 depending on industry. Property rider per $100 of value. Bundle discounts.

name: Commercial Trucking Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate your commercial trucking insurance cost. Covers primary liability, cargo, and physical damage.
inputs: Number of trucks, annual revenue, cargo type, states operated, DOT number
formula: Primary liability $6000-$15000 per truck. Cargo based on limit. Physical damage based on vehicle value.

name: Business Owners Policy Calculator
description: Estimate your BOP insurance cost. Bundles general liability and commercial property for small businesses.
inputs: Industry, revenue, square footage, property value, inventory value, state
formula: BOP base rate $0.30-$0.90 per $100 of insured value. GL component based on revenue and industry.

name: Workers Compensation Insurance Calculator
description: Estimate workers comp costs by state, class code, and payroll. Essential for all employers.
inputs: State, industry class code, annual payroll, experience mod, employees
formula: Premium = (payroll / 100) * class_rate * experience_mod. Rates vary 0.25-15.00 per $100 by class and state.
